summary: The repeat I requested ran the wrong revision: receipt 8f0b76d0cd49441c81ecb603f1fcd527 is a build failure of the superseded partial-restart experiment, whose captured harness still used helpers declared in a sibling file that is not copied into the package (undefined: waitLeaderAmong, waitAllConfigured, configSizes, fullConfigCount), so no test ran. I recorded that plainly as my error — I named the superseded experiment rather than its correction — retained the receipt as a setup failure that carries no evidence, and noted that the partial-restart observations cited in the interpretation come only from the corrected revision's receipt 7afe8c0403874dbeb0a917a3ee9ed837. The repeat is re-requested against the corrected, self-contained experiment (b826595f01b844f9b95efe7b29d757dd-experiment) to complete reproducibility for the live-quorum progress claim.
